'''2006 Maryland State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship held on Saturday 17 June 2006 at Renaissance Games in Fallston, Maryland, with [[Kevin Elia]] as tournament director, as he had been the year before.<ref name="pcf-10140-139455">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=139455#139455 MD States - 6/17/06], Tim Simon (Aglets), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (1 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618095754/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=10140&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref> [[Michael Pistone]] won with a 5–1 record and won the final confrontation against [[Steve Yaeger]].<ref name="pcf-10140-141805">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141805#141805 MD States - 6/17/06], Steve Yaeger (Rentax), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (17 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618095754/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=10140&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Renaissance Games, Fallston, Maryland<ref name="pcf-10140-139455" />
* '''Dates:''' 17 June 2006<ref name="pcf-10140-139455" /><ref name="pcf-10140-141805" />
* '''Time:''' registration 11:15 am; start 12 pm<ref name="pcf-10140-139455" />
* '''Format:''' announced as "the normal 3 rounds of Swiss", followed by a Final Confrontation; decklists required; clear sleeves not allowed<ref name="pcf-10140-139455" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10, used towards prize support (boosters and other items)<ref name="pcf-10140-139455" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Kevin Elia]]<ref name="pcf-10140-139455" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Pistone]]<ref name="pcf-10140-141805" />

== Organization ==

[[Tim Simon]] posted the announcement on 1 June 2006.<ref name="pcf-10140-139455" /> On 15 June [[Nick Kolnik]] confirmed that the errata issued earlier that week was immediately legal for tournament play, in answer to a question about whether the new virtual card revisions would be legal at the event.<ref name="pcf-10140-141274">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141274#141274 MD States - 6/17/06], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (15 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618095754/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=10140&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref>

== Results ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Place !! Player !! Record !! Dark !! Light
|-
| 1st || [[Michael Pistone]] || 5–1 || Solid Walkers with Black Sun Fleet and Ice Storm || Throne Room Mains
|-
| 2nd || [[Steve Yaeger]] || 4–2 || SYCFA Fear || Tatooine mains (Toche Station Jedi Presence beatdown)
|}

In the final confrontation Pistone won the first game by 20 with his Walkers deck against Yaeger's Tatooine mains, and Yaeger won the second game by 9 with his Fear deck. Results and decks are from Yaeger's post on the evening of the event.<ref name="pcf-10140-141805" /> Pistone also wrote that he had qualified for the [[2006 World Championship]] at the event.<ref name="pcf-9443-140978">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=140978#140978 Qualifiers for Worlds 2006], Michael Pistone (Pistone84), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (13 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618055549/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141112 Internet Archive]</ref>
